title: Allow omitting timestamps from log output
body:
### Feature request description

Some, or perhaps all, podman output logged to `journald` includes superfluous and, frankly rather verbose, timestamps like so:
```
Jul 05 12:07:15 podman[4577]: 2026-07-05 12:07:15.149935425 +0200 CEST m=+0.027362038 container create 002f929df6280138a9433ee244517a7da88d8a1c594ced8421d53ac943334c85 (image=docker.io/traefik/whoami:latest, name=whoami, org.opencontainers.image.revision=7e57190724ca7c0a74aa7f878b6cefe13b11994f, org.opencontainers.image.documentation=https://github.com/traefik/whoami, org.opencontainers.image.created=2025-03-13T14:25:39Z, org.opencontainers.image.version=1.11.0, org.opencontainers.image.description=Tiny Go webserver that prints OS information and HTTP request to output, org.opencontainers.image.title=whoami, PODMAN_SYSTEMD_UNIT=whoami.service, org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/traefik/whoami, org.opencontainers.image.url=https://github.com/traefik/whoami)
```

### Suggest potential solution

Add an option (probably in `containers.conf`) that disables log timestamps, that I can just use those of `journald`:

```
Jul 05 12:07:15 podman[4577]: container create 002f929df6280138a9433ee244517a7da88d8a1c594ced8421d53ac943334c85 (image=docker.io/traefik/whoami:latest, name=whoami, org.opencontainers.image.revision=7e57190724ca7c0a74aa7f878b6cefe13b11994f, org.opencontainers.image.documentation=https://github.com/traefik/whoami, org.opencontainers.image.created=2025-03-13T14:25:39Z, org.opencontainers.image.version=1.11.0, org.opencontainers.image.description=Tiny Go webserver that prints OS information and HTTP request to output, org.opencontainers.image.title=whoami, PODMAN_SYSTEMD_UNIT=whoami.service, org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/traefik/whoami, org.opencontainers.image.url=https://github.com/traefik/whoami)
```
